messages:
jon: CI shard 42 went red on the hosted integ suite — streaming tests failing intermittently, anyone else seeing it?
ci-bot: [automated] shard=42 failed: streaming/stream_auth.spec.js (handshake timeout), toolcall/schema_validation.spec.js (payload validation). logs: https://ci.redwood/tests/42/logs
maria: saw a burst of 401s around 08:37 UTC, looked like a token KID mismatch in a few samples but JWKS endpoint returned expected keys at the time.
sasha: can you paste a minimal failing request/response? a few samples would help.
jon: here's one of the failing excerpts:```
POST /v1/hosted/stream?model=gpt-x HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1...
Content-Type: application/json

{ "input": "hello", "tools": [{"name":"calculator"}] }

<= HTTP/1.1 502
<= connection: close
<= x-stream-error: handshake_reset
```
jon: and later on same run:```
<= HTTP/1.1 401
<= x-auth-error: kid_not_found
```
tim: quick hypothesis — infra team rolled a proxy tweak this morning that shortens upstream idle keepalive. long-lived streaming connections might be getting reset mid-handshake. also #8472 touched the tool call payload shape (tool.name -> tool_id).
maria: +1 on the tool schema note. I spotted #8472 in the changelog; could explain the payload validation failures. but the 401/kid_not_found smell is separate. maybe key caching TTL mismatch between auth service and proxy.
sasha: can we trigger a targeted rerun for shard 42 with diag enabled and KID rotation disabled? cc @eng-oncall
jon: requesting rerun now with --diag and env KID_ROTATION=off, tagging @eng-oncall — will paste rerun id when scheduled.
ci-bot: rerun scheduled: https://ci.redwood/runs/8921 (shard 42, diag=true). ETA ~6m.
eng-oncall: picked up rerun, running now. will post updates in this thread.
eng-oncall: rerun finished — results: streaming handshake still flaky (2/5 attempts hit 90s timeout), tool schema test now returns 422 validation: missing required field 'input_schema' on tool payload.
sasha: listing recent merges in the last 2 hours: #8472 (tool proto rename), #8501 (proxy keepalive/timeout tweak), #8510 (minor logging).
tim: I'm going to revert #8501 on staging to see if streaming stabilizes there. pushing revert now.
maria: also check auth service kid cache TTL and proxy JWKS fetch timing — if keys rotate while proxy caches an old kid mapping, we hit kid_not_found.
jon: kicking off a bisect: revert #8501 first, if flaky persists revert #8472 next. will report the bisect steps & results here.
ci-bot: bisect queued: https://ci.redwood/bisect/177 (steps: revert #8501 -> run -> revert #8472 -> run)
eng-oncall: update after revert #8501 on staging: streaming tests pass consistently on staging for several runs, hosted smoke still shows occasional handshake timeouts but frequency reduced. propagating to infra team for deeper proxy keepalive review.
sasha: sounds like an interaction between keepalive behavior and client/server handshake timing + schema changes. created INFRA-912 to track cross-team follow-up (proxy keepalive, jwks cache TTL, and tool schema compatibility).
jon: thanks all — will add notes to the PRs and follow up on INFRA-912. if anyone sees more flakes, drop the short logs here and ping me :thumbsup:
